### /cedric-mail — Privacy and support

These public information pages do not collect or process Gmail data. They contain no sign-in form and are not an OAuth callback or public mail-data endpoint. The site's existing Cloudflare Web Analytics may measure visits and page performance; it is separate from Gmail access.

### /cedric-mail/privacy — These public pages

The app information and privacy pages do not collect or process Gmail data. They contain no sign-in widget or public mail-data endpoint and are not an OAuth callback. The website host adds Cloudflare Web Analytics on eligible visits to collect page-visit and performance measurements. This visitor analytics is separate from Gmail access: Gmail data and OAuth credentials are not supplied to it by the connector. The host may also process ordinary web-request information to deliver these pages. Other pages on the owner's website have their own privacy policy.

edits.description: Replace an unverified script-free claim with observed hosting behavior. Separate ordinary visitor measurements from Gmail access. No new tracking, Google-data use or marketing claims.
